propositions: The `rebar metrics` subcommand must parse `--since` and `--until` date-range arguments and `--output json|text` format flags to render the full metric registry over the specified range.
The command wires as a single explicit `if sub == 'metrics'` dispatch arm in `_cli/__init__.py`, mirrored after `init` and `scratch`, on the reads path that ensures store initialization.

The render loop must call `registry.evaluate(spec, ctx)` for every `MetricSpec` in the registry, wrapping each call in try-except to render unavailable metrics on compute errors rather than crashing the command.

JSON output (default) must emit a map with `since`, `until`, and `metrics` keys, where each metric entry contains either `{lens, source, confidence, value}` (from spec and MetricValue) or `{unavailable: {reason, accruing_since}}`.
Text output must list one line per registered metric id in registry order with id, lens/source, and value-or-unavailable reason, deterministically covering every registered metric.

The command must import `rebar.metrics` (the package, not just registry) to hydrate REGISTRY via reader module side-effects, and must not import any `rebar.metrics.adapters` module (enforced by source-level scan test).
